text.title: इंडियन रिवाइज्ड वर्जन (IRV) हिंदी - 2019
text.english: The Indian Revised Version Holy Bible in the Hindi language of India
text.changes: The verse wording is unchanged. The book introductions, section headings, study notes and the cross-references the edition sets apart as notes are not shown (16 verses keep a reference printed inside the verse, as eBible.org’s own text does); the verses are laid out by Biblia. These changes are not endorsed by the original licensor.

files: The JSON files of this folder are the verses as Biblia reads them, shared under the same licence (Creative Commons Attribution Share-Alike 4.0).
